review_summary: Question 9 (Magnetic Fields, Hall Effect, and Electromagnetic Induction) verified with PASS across all 2 leaves (a) and (b). Leaf (a) verifies the Hall voltage waveform against time: because Hall voltage V_H = (BI)/(ntq) is directly proportional to magnetic flux density B for constant probe current and orientation, V_H replicates the B-t graph profile, giving a horizontal line at +V_0 from t = 0 to t_1 (B1), a straight line with constant negative gradient passing through 0 at t_2 and ending at -2V_0 at t_3 (B1), and a horizontal line at -2V_0 from t_3 to t_4 (B1). Leaf (b) verifies the induced e.m.f. waveform against time: by Faraday's law of induction E = -d(NΦ)/dt = -NA(dB/dt), induced e.m.f. is proportional to the gradient of the B-t graph, yielding E = 0 during constant flux intervals 0 to t_1 and t_3 to t_4 (B1), and a non-zero (M1) constant magnitude horizontal line (A1) during the uniform flux decrease from t_1 to t_3. All progressive hints, teacher walkthroughs, AI rubrics, and curriculum taxonomy mappings are fully compliant.
